english:
Lunges up to 6 meters to strike an enemy, dealing <pve 390 /> <pvp [100] /> damage, <arc Jolting /> them, and releasing chain lightning. Has 2 ability charges exclusively on an <arc Arc /> subclass.

Chain lightning deals <pve 265 /> <pvp [54] /> damage to enemies within 9 meters and can chain up to 5 times. It cannot chain back to the most recently targeted enemy.

Being <arc Amplified /> causes the attack to release two sets of chain lightning that each target a different enemy, doubling the maximum number of enemies hit. Each enemy can still only be hit once by chain lightning.

source.text:
Melee Attack with an extended lunge distance of 6 meters.
Arc Subclass Exclusive: Has 2 Ability Charges.

Directly strikes an enemy, dealing 390 [100] damage, inflicting Jolt, and causing them to release chain lightning.
Chain lightning deals 265 [54] damage to enemies within 9 metres, chaining towards enemies up to a maximum of 5 times. Cannot chain to the most recently targeted enemy.

While Amplified:
Releases two sets of chain lightning, each targeting a different enemy, doubling the maximum amount of enemies hit. Enemies can still only be hit once by chain lightning.
Base Cooldown: 131.7 seconds

Chunk Scalar: 0.9x
